info.title: Sprinklr Universal API
info.description: Sprinklr is an AI-native customer experience platform. This wrapper provides OAuth-authenticated access to Sprinklr API 2.0 resources including search, standard entities, custom entities, accounts, tasks, cases, profiles, messages, and comments.
